newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine c. bank halts issue T-bill auction details.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine c. bank halts issue T-bill auction details.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank has stopped providing detailed results of auctions on its Treasury bill market, a deputy manager of the bank's credit deparment said on Friday.
The manager, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters he was unable to provide reasons for the move.
Dealers at Ukrainian banks told Reuters they did not receive full details of auctions they participated in on April 11 and 12, only a document stating the results of their purchases.
Alexander Patoka, chief of the Finance Ministry's securities department, said he did not understand the central bank's actions and would comment on them once he found out the reasoning behind them.
"We are interested in a transparent market," he said.
Western bankers were not available for comment.
